about: How long each growing file stays live (docs/RETENTION.md). The owner may edit company/work/ops/retention.json: an artifact listed there replaces the default with the same id; a default not listed there still applies. Policies: roll-monthly (entries older than keepDays move into <dir>/archive/<name>/YYYY-MM.<ext>, a pointer line stays), keep-last-N (all but the newest keepLast entries move the same way), keep-N-days (same as roll-monthly, by days), size-rotate (copytruncate past maxBytes, keep gzipped copies), archive-dir (finished records in a folder move to its archive/), run-journal (StarNet's run journals: resolved ones removed, old unresolved ones gzipped aside), never (not touched; reason says who bounds it). bound: what `retention.js audit` holds the live file to (bytes, rows, days of the oldest live entry).
